title: UserDeckIntent
description: Configuration schema capturing a user's deck-review intent, playstyle preferences, and constraints for Commander deck reviews.

deck_vision.description: Captures whether the deck review is for a new brew, tuning up an existing deck, or performing an overhaul, along with custom vision notes.

intent.description: Primary goal: 'new_build' (creating a fresh decklist from scratch), 'tune_up' (optimizing and refining an existing list), or 'overhaul' (major rebuild/restructuring of theme, commander, or colors).

description.description: User's stated vision, favorite cards, pet interactions, or thematic focus for the deck.

target_turn_win.description: Expected or desired turn window to present a win or establish an overwhelming board state.

target_power_level.description: Target power level on the traditional 1-10 Commander scale or named power tiers.

scale.description: Numeric power level rating from 1 (jank / meme deck) to 10 (cEDH / maximum optimization).

tier.description: Named power tier: 'casual' (1-4, low interaction/precon), 'focused' (5-6, synergy & clear gameplan), 'optimized' (7-8, efficient mana curve & answers), 'competitive' (9-10, cEDH, fast combos & free interaction).

budget_constraints.description: Financial constraints and limits for recommended deck upgrades or substitutions.

no_budget.description: When true, financial constraints are disabled (budget caps are disregarded/unlimited).

total_budget.description: Maximum total expenditure limit for proposed deck upgrades in the given currency. If no_budget is true, must be null.

max_card_price.description: Maximum price cap allowed for any individual card recommendation in the given currency. Must not exceed total_budget when both are set.

currency.description: Currency code for evaluating card pricing.

preferred_win_conditions.description: Preferred ways the deck should achieve victory, along with win conditions to avoid.

primary.description: Primary intended victory route: combat (creature combat/go-wide/go-tall), combo (infinite loops or instant win lines), attrition (grind, drain, incremental value), commander_damage (voltron lethal commander hits), alternate_wincon (cards stating 'you win the game'), mill (opponent library depletion), burn (direct non-combat damage), lockout (hard stax lock).

disliked_or_excluded.description: Win conditions explicitly disallowed (cannot overlap with primary or secondary win conditions).

custom_win_conditions.description: Free-text or user-specific win conditions (e.g. 'Maze\'s End guildgates', 'Biovisionary clones').

archetype_preferences.description: Preferred deck archetype and gameplay themes, as well as archetypes to strictly avoid.

secondary_archetypes.description: Secondary archetypes or hybrid sub-themes (e.g. tokens with aristocrats).

excluded_archetypes.description: Archetypes explicitly banned from consideration (e.g. no stax, no group hug).

custom_themes.description: Free-text archetype tags or tribal themes (e.g. 'Dinosaurs', 'Landfall burn', 'Equipment voltron').

freeform_notes.description: Any additional freeform notes, rule 0 considerations, or playgroup context.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value metadata for downstream intake and orchestration pipelines.
